title: [YouPass Collect] - Coal mining site redevelopment comparison
prompt: The maps below show a coal mining site before and after redevelopment. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the transformation of a coal mining site before and after its redevelopment into a visitor attraction.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the site underwent significant changes, with most of the original mining-related facilities being replaced by tourist amenities. While the entrance to the underground mine remained in the same location, its purpose shifted from serving workers to accommodating visitors, and the two waste tips in the eastern section were completely converted into recreational areas.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the buildings in the western and central portions of the site, the office and the staff changing room below it were combined to form a museum. The car park in the southwest remained unchanged. In the central area, the medical room was replaced by a cafe, and the lorry park was converted into a souvenir shop. Meanwhile, the entrance to the underground mine, formerly designated for workers, maintained its location but was repurposed to serve visitors.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the eastern section, both waste tips were entirely redeveloped. Waste Tip 1, located in the northeast, gave way to a digger driving track, while the area between the two former waste tips became a picnic area. Further south, Waste Tip 2 was replaced by a children's play area. Additionally, a footpath was constructed, connecting the souvenir shop and cafe to the newly created recreational zones in the east.
